profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Forterra
profile.summary:
With a freshly minted Bachelor of Science in Computer Science from the University of Maryland Baltimore County, my journey has been a blend of academia and hands-on experience. 

My tenure at University of Maryland Baltimore County taught me the value of meticulousness and efficiency, skills that I eagerly apply to my programming pursuits in C++, React.js, and Python.  I'm eager to contribute these perspectives and experiences to a dynamic team, aiming to innovate and excel in our collective endeavors.

positions.title: Front End Associate
positions.description: Worked in a fast-paced environment serving hundreds of customers per day, completing extensive cash handling, and ensuring the register was fully balanced with 100% accuracy, leading to increased responsibility training three new cashiers.

positions.title: Warehouse Associate
positions.description: Carefully packed and shipped thousands of books in an efficient manner to reduce shipping costs while ensuring the quality of the product and prevent an unhappy customer.

honors.title: Best Space App
honors.issuer: Issued by HackUMBC & US Space Force · Nov 2021

volunteerExperiences.description:
Worked with a large committee of fellow students to plan and host an overnight charity event at a local
high school, raising over $10,000 for childhood cancer research in a single night.

Volunteered at local institutions including the local hospital and assisted living center by decorating for
events and helping care for the elderly to positively impact the community.
